observations.behavior: Adds a 15s dwell timer and a single-shot intent registration when the Replay Vision scanner list is viewed, while preventing registration on mount-only or repeated filter changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Records a 'shallow product intent' for the Replay Vision product, gated on user dwell rather than route mount, to avoid false positives from accidental page loads or bounces.

observations.behavior: Defines the dwell threshold constant and its rationale.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the 15-second dwell gate used by the Replay Vision intent registration.
